name: Halli Galli Table Dance
kurzbeschreibung:
**Halli Galli Table Dance in Gerlos**

Experience the lively **Halli Galli** at the **Almrauschalm** in **Gerlos**, a traditional Tyrolean table dance that will get your feet moving! After a hearty meal of **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Speckknödel**, and **Tyrolean dumplings**, enjoy the infectious rhythm of the **Harmonika** and **Zither** as locals and visitors join in for a night of fun and camaraderie. Whether you're a seasoned dancer or just here to clap along, this is a must-visit in the **Zillertal**!
